basic_info.description: This bright and inviting 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom single-family home offers an impeccable blend of contemporary design and functional living. The sunlit main level features an open-concept living, dining, and kitchen area. A stylish fireplace anchors the living room, complimented by built-in cabinetry in the dining room. The updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances includes a peninsula for casual dining. The seamless layout is ideal for everyday living and entertaining. The three spacious bedrooms are located in the rear of the house. One is the primary suite with ensuite bathroom and large closet. Attic access from main hallway allows for abundant, convenient storage. Downstairs is a massive space with high ceilings just waiting for the next owner to develop it. Two car side by side garage, laundry and access to the private yard complete this level. Forest Knolls is one of San Francisco's most centrally located neighborhoods, just minutes from Midtown Terrace Playground, Forest Hill Muni, and West Portal Village and Inner Sunset shops and cafes.
